description: Stop continuous monitoring of a saved case. Use when the user asks to stop monitoring, stop alerts, pause watching, or unfollow a case. The case, its docket history, its Case Passport and its CaseMail address all remain; only the monitoring stops.

matter_id.description: The CaseMagic matter id, as returned by create_case_passport or shown in an earlier result. Omit it when the account follows exactly one case and that is the one meant.

name: stop_watch
title: Stop watching the case
